aws_api_gateway_rest_api.notes: policy is mutually exclusive with aws_api_gateway_rest_api_policy resource; managed separately

aws_appstream_image_builder.notes: image_name conflicts with image_arn — only one of image_arn or image_name can be specified at creation; image_name is treated as observed-only

aws_autoscaling_group.notes: mutually exclusive with aws_autoscaling_attachment resource; these fields must not be set in ForProvider

aws_docdb_cluster.notes: cluster_members is managed via aws_docdb_cluster_instance resources, not directly on the cluster

aws_instance.notes: security_groups is the legacy EC2-Classic security group name list; vpc_security_group_ids is used for VPC instances

aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream.notes: arn is a computed-only field returned by AWS after creation

aws_kinesis_stream.notes: arn is a computed-only field returned by AWS after creation

aws_network_acl.notes: mutually exclusive with aws_network_acl_rule resource; rules must not be set inline on the ACL

aws_opensearch_domain.notes: access_policies is managed via aws_opensearch_domain_policy resource; must not be set inline

aws_route_table.notes: route is mutually exclusive with aws_route resource; propagating_vgws is mutually exclusive with aws_vpn_gateway_route_propagation

aws_s3_bucket.notes: these fields are each managed by dedicated aws_s3_bucket_* resources (accelerate_configuration, acl, cors_configuration, lifecycle_configuration, logging, object_lock_configuration, policy, replication_configuration, request_payment_configuration, server_side_encryption_configuration, versioning, website_configuration); arn is computed-only

aws_secretsmanager_secret.notes: rotation_rules and rotation_lambda_arn are managed via aws_secretsmanager_secret_rotation; policy is managed via aws_secretsmanager_secret_policy

aws_security_group.notes: mutually exclusive with aws_security_group_rule resource; inline rules must not be set

aws_vpc_endpoint.notes: mutually exclusive with aws_vpc_endpoint_subnet_association, aws_vpc_endpoint_security_group_association, aws_vpc_endpoint_route_table_association resources

aws_vpc_peering_connection.notes: accepter and requester connection options are mutually exclusive with aws_vpc_peering_connection_options resource
